paragraphs: Frontline Education sells software that school districts use to run hiring, onboarding, payroll, absences, and professional development as connected systems. The pitch is that it joins up the tools teachers, staff, and administrators rely on in one place.

Beyond personnel work, it helps special educators and school nurses manage documentation, compliance, and reporting. Business-side tools help district leaders track key areas so they can understand spending and oversee district resources. Published case studies describe districts modernizing hiring on connected recruiting workflows.

The company says its software supports over 4.1 million users daily in education across the US and abroad. District data is monitored around the clock in five physically and geographically secure datacenters in the United States and Canada. The security page states SOC 2 certification and Texas RAMP certification for selling software solutions in Texas. It also says its products and security program are aligned with FERPA and HIPAA. The company signed the Student Privacy Pledge.

quote.text: Frontline Education’s software solutions support over 4.1 million users daily in the education field across the US and abroad.
